_readme: Curated per-game emulation fixes imported into ArcadeGameProfile via `arcade-gameconfig-import`. Reviewed + source-cited; NOT auto-pulled (no clean machine-readable per-game DB exists). NOTE: the DC double-speed class (Sonic Adventure, Jet Set Radio, and all 30fps-content DC games) is now FIXED at the stack level by audio-driven pacing (worker patch 0010) — see docs/arcade-per-game-config.md. The forcedFps entries that used to live here were REMOVED as obsolete (audio pacing is correct in menus too, keeps audio in sync, and needs no per-game data; a static forcedFps would wrongly halve a game's 60fps menus). forcedFps remains in the model only as a fallback for cores that emit no audio. This dataset now holds only coreOptions-based fixes (widescreen, region, rendering, Windows-CE mode, etc.), which carry no speed risk. Add entries as {system,title,coreOptions:{k:v},notes,source,confidence}.
